title: Personal Checking: Conversion of an Existing Account Into Private Client Checking
content:
## Policy entry

Personal Checking lets an existing active account move into Private Client Checking by conversion, which is made at the owner's request. In such a conversion the balance requirement of the Private Client entry gate is checked against the owner's relationship balance as it stands on the date the request is dealt with, and the entry floor and the treatment of mortgage principal used in that check are the target tier's own, not those of the tier the account holds at the time. The ordinary requirements of any conversion made at a customer's request apply alongside the balance check. A conversion either ends with the account recorded in Private Client Checking or ends with nothing written and the account left in its present tier.

## What the owner sees after a conversion

The new tier name shows on the account at once. The account number, balance, activity, statement cycle, overdraft election and overdraft protection link all stay as they were, and no fee is posted for the change.

## Conversion tool

`convert_checking_tier_696add48` is operated on the agent side: unlock it to make it callable, and the agent — not the customer — performs the call. Each call records the named tier as the account's tier from today. The tool writes exactly the tier it is given and does not test whether the customer qualifies.

### Parameters

- `checking_account_id` — reference number of the checking account being converted, obtained from the checking account lookup.
- `customer_id` — the owner's customer reference number, obtained from the customer profile lookup.
- `variant_name` — the official full name of the tier the account is to become. The accepted values are exactly: `Access Checking` (the checkless tier that never pays into overdraft), `Student Checking` (the tier for younger owners within its age span), `Everyday Checking` (the standard tier whose fee can be waived), `Interest Checking` (the entry interest-bearing tier), `Premier Checking` (the relationship tier whose relationship balance counts mortgage principal) and `Private Client Checking` (the top tier, which calls for the Private Client relationship balance).

### Confirmation returned

A single sentence names the account's reference number, the tier it had before the call and the tier now recorded. Its return means the conversion is on record.
